name: Solo — one worker plans/implements/refines, separate reviewers
description: One worker plans, implements and refines its own work; reviewers are spawned once an implementation exists and re-prompted each round.

plan.description: Spawn and brief a plan worker — scoped goal, constraints, completion sentinel — and end the turn. On its wake: approve, reject with feedback, answer its question, or abandon. It implements what it planned, so pick its model tier for the whole job.

implement.description: Re-brief it in place if it drifts from the plan you approved, and wait for its completion sentinel before treating the work as reviewable. Its worktree is what you land.

review.description: Spawn an adversarial reviewer onto the implementer's worktree, briefed to inspect only — never edit, stage or commit — to default to skepticism, and to answer `REVIEW_CLEAN` or a findings list. Give it the plan you approved: what was approved is the bar, not your brief. Run several at once when the work deserves more than one lens (correctness, security, test coverage), each briefed to its own; give every one of them the same bar. Never prompt a reviewer and the implementer in the same turn: they share one worktree.

refine.description: Relay only the findings worth fixing to the implementer; on its refined wake send the same reviewers back. You arbitrate each round — worth fixing → refine again, else land; escalate only on a call you cannot resolve.
